code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Extend each horizontal foreground pattern to the right edge, in color 1.
    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    fg=[x for x in set(x for r in grid for x in r) if x!=bg]
    if not fg: return out
    # The repeated foreground color forms a pattern; extend from its rightmost occurrence
    # when the row contains a pattern and trailing non-pattern cells.
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        inds=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v in fg]
        if inds:
            # only extend after last foreground marker where there is a trailing run
            last=max(inds)
            if last<w-1:
                for c in range(last+1,w): out[r][c]=1
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
